notes.title: Ver.1.0.5 Hotfix is now live!
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for playing POGO Stadium![/p][p]We’ve just released a Hotfix update (Ver.1.0.5). This update addresses an issue discovered during our internal debugging where the game would sometimes fail to recognize controllers when multiple controllers are connected.[/p][p][/p][p]◆ Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where controllers would not be recognized when multiple controllers are connected[/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback is always welcome, please keep sharing your thoughts with us 👇[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Ver.1.0.4 Patch is now live!
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for playing POGO Stadium!  [/p][p]We’ve just released a new patch (Ver.1.0.4).  [/p][p]Thanks to community reports and shared Player.log files, we were able to identify and fix the root cause of the loading screen issue.  [/p][p][/p][p]◆ Fixes  [/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would get stuck on the loading screen when using certain system language or region settings  [/p][/*][/list][p]
Your feedback has been a huge help in improving the game.  [/p][p]Please keep sharing your thoughts with us 👇  [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Ver.1.0.3 Hotfix is now live!
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for playing POGO Stadium![/p][p]We’ve just released a Hotfix update (Ver.1.0.3).
This update addresses the issue reported in the community where the game could not be launched and would get stuck on the loading screen.[/p][p]
◆ Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game could not start on certain environments[/p][/*][/list][p]
Your feedback is always welcome, please keep sharing your thoughts with us 👇[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: We have updated Demo version 1.0.1!
notes.notes: [p]Hey, we just updated Demo version 1.0.1![/p][p]◆ Changes [/p][list][*][p]Implemented the main theme BGM – it’s an upbeat, energetic track![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added the opening video.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added a special bonus video that plays after clearing the final stage.[/p][/*][/list][p]     ※ Even if you’ve already cleared it, you can watch it by clearing the final stage again.[/p][list][*][p]Added a counter display for post-clear “completion challenge” elements.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved several in-game effects.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the rhythm was off in some BGM tracks.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed various other bugs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Bugs or feedback? [/p][p]Let us know what you think! [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for always supporting “POGO Stadium”! [/p][p]We appreciate it and hope you keep enjoying it.[/p]
